question: ________ is the first synthetic fibre made by man.
solution:
Correct answer is __Nylon.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

__
 
• Nylon, the first synthetic fiber in the "fully synthetic" feeling of that word, was developed by Wallace Carothers, an American researcher at the chemical firm DuPont in the 1930s.
 
• Nylon is a generic designation for a family of synthetic polymers composed of polyamides.
 
• Nylon is a silk-like thermoplastic, usually made from petroleum, that can be melt-processed into fibers, films, or shapes.
 
• Nylon is the first fully processed synthetic fibre, made from coal, water and air.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Spandex is a synthetic fabric that is prized for its elasticity.​ 
 
• Acrylic fiber fabrics are made from a synthetic polymer called acrylonitrile.
 
• Silicones are a durable alternative to conventional plastics that preserves our environment.
